title: Your Team's Agents Are All Shipping to the Same Code at Once - Patrick Debois, Tessl
description:
Your whole team runs coding agents now, and all of them land on the same main branch. Continuous delivery wasn't built for that. Patrick Debois maps what breaks when a software factory goes multiplayer, and the patterns that fix it: one main for the agents, one board for the people.

Patrick Debois, Tessl: https://x.com/patrickdebois | https://tessl.io
